retirements.value: REFUTED on its own named forward test (G23), by four specialists working independently on four day-classes. Its falsifier as written - 'a burn-confirmed CDD add that fails to deliver, in G23+' - discharges. (1) MECHANISM, D-0709: the CDD-add limb is a CONSTANT - d_gw_cdd at horizon 1 is positive 20/20 days across G22+G23 (min +0.129, max +2.256); a limb that never changes sign cannot gate, so whatever discriminating work the gate appeared to do in G22 was done by wind/burn. D tested and REJECTED the obvious repair: the forward integral does not sort direction (~10/19; the most positive forward limb of the 20 days delivered -60). (2) RECORD, C-0708: three clean up-fires in G23 - 0708 (-520), 0715 (-60), 0716 (-20) - 0 of 3 delivered; 0706 excluded honestly as unevaluable. (3) BOTH POLARITIES, E-0710 (the play's own author): the up arm re-run against the realized weekend passes both limbs and says 'flip UP +300..+800' into a -620 Monday, while the both-ways clause CAPPED a correct DOWN read to a -150..-200 floor against a -660 actual. E: 'Not softened - it is my play, and the G22 support (6 instances, one block, never spanning) should be read as having been insufficient.' (4) THE CLEANEST EVIDENCE IS PRE-GRAFT AND INSIDE THE PLAY'S OWN EVIDENCE LIST, C-0715: G22 0624 and 0625 carry the IDENTICAL served burn of 39.3 with 0625 on lower wind, and delivered +800 and -60 on consecutive sessions - the play cites 0624 and is silent on its twin. WHY IT FAILED (E's mechanism, corroborated by D-0716 and C-0714): the gate reads burn as a NUMERATOR WITH NO BALANCE-CLEARING DENOMINATOR, so when the balance loosens at the demand peak, burn confirmation is BEARISH information; +1.0 Bcf/d is 2.3% of burn against storage of 2,983 in injection season, which is why the numerator is always positive and always small. WHAT SURVIVES: the DAMPER limb (0709/0710 both wind-ramping, both fell) - carried forward inside weather.burn_is_demand_arrival_not_direction. Retired rather than amended because the failure is the play's core claim, not its calibration. ||| THE DISSENT, RECORDED IN FULL BECAUSE IT CORRECTS THE TALLY (Greg, S110: 'record the instance where the one had it right and the four said it was wrong and why they were wrong'). ONE specialist dissented: C-0707 returned MIS-SCOPED, NOT REFUTED, and it was RIGHT on the point it made. Its argument: the blind confirmed the gate off a HOLIDAY-SUNDAY grid row (period 2026-07-05) that the gate's OWN weekday-normalization rule disqualifies; read on the valid comparator in the same row (gas_chg_7d_mwh +1,012,635, Sunday-over-Sunday by construction) the gate CONFIRMED, and its day delivered +160 UP. C-0707 stated plainly: 'the falsifier is NOT discharged on my day (a burn-confirmed CDD add that DID deliver)', and it DECLINED to bank a refutation on the nearest candidate (0708) because that day is roll-confounded. WHY THE OTHER FOUR WERE WRONG ON THE TALLY: the refuting record was built as '3 clean up-fires, 0 of 3 delivered' (0708, 0715, 0716) with 0706 excluded as unevaluable - and 0707, a clean fire that DID deliver, was counted by NOBODY, because it was not any refuter's own day and each specialist works only its own causal slice. CORRECTED RECORD: 1 of 4 delivered, not 0 of 3. THE RETIREMENT STILL STANDS, AND THAT IS THE POINT: it does not rest on the tally. The two arguments that kill the play are MECHANISM arguments and survive C-0707's instance untouched - (a) D-0709's constant limb (d_gw_cdd h1 positive 20/20 across two groups; a limb that never changes sign cannot gate, so the gate cannot have been what discriminated on 0707 either - something else carried that day), and (b) C-0715's pre-graft pair from inside the play's own evidence list (G22 0624 and 0625, IDENTICAL served burn 39.3, delivered +800 and -60 on consecutive sessions). A play can be right on a day and still be an instrument that cannot discriminate. LESSON RECORDED: per-day causal isolation means no specialist sees another's instance, so any TALLY assembled from independent slices is systematically incomplete - counts must be RECOMPUTED AT THE COORDINATOR across all ten days before any tally-based claim is merged. Mechanism claims are unaffected by this.

new_plays_proposed.trigger: the prior session's terminal-phase impact coefficient k3 = |ph3 price change| / |ph3 signed flow| is NUMB (<= 0.05 on >= 500 lots)
new_plays_proposed.read: the tape's marginal price impact per unit of aggressor imbalance CARRIES to the next session. A numb prior terminal phase means the next day's NET is small regardless of how large the flow is - and the corollary that makes it usable: it is a NET suppressor, NOT a volatility suppressor.
new_plays_proposed.call: size the next day's NET small (|day move| <= ~200 class); do NOT compress the expected RANGE by the same factor
new_plays_proposed.requires: prior session phase-3 price change and signed flow (tape_conditions) - ALL PRE-CUTOFF, so this is BLIND-LEGAL, not refine-only
new_plays_proposed.scope: sign-free by construction - it bounds magnitude, never direction
new_plays_proposed.evidence: C-0714 derived it and used it: k3 carried from 0713 (0.026) against served flow +3,747 gave +170 against a +200 actual. The week-2 series is the demonstration: flows of +3,747 / +6,326 / +1,089 / +1,333 produced only +200 / -60 / -20 / +180.
new_plays_proposed.forward_evidence: CORPUS SEARCHED, INSTANCES FOUND (D24 state a): n=6 spanning G20+G23, 5/6 at <= $200 (median 115) against a base rate of 12/40 days (30%) and a block median |net| of $535. ONE LIVE COUNTEREXAMPLE NAMED AND NOT EXPLAINED AWAY: g20 0605, -1,350. Independent out-of-sample instance in a day-class C did not sample (B-0706, block-open Monday): k3_prev 0.041 NUMB - reached by a DIFFERENT road, holiday thinness rather than a liquidity void - and the day landed in class at +100. All four numb seams in G22+G23 land in class. B's declared weakness: its ph3 flow is 489 vs the stated 500-lot floor, a boundary instance by 2%. QUALIFIER B MEASURED: numb compresses NET 6.5x (median |net| 80 vs 520) but RANGE only 1.5x (875 vs 1,350) - its own day was +100 net around a 970 range with a -840 low.
new_plays_proposed.falsifier: a numb prior terminal phase followed by a large next-day NET with no new driver; or the range compressing as much as the net (which would make it a volatility rule, not a net rule)

new_plays_proposed.trigger: a session phase prices materially on near-zero net flow (a liquidity VOID: the resting bid or offer withdraws rather than size changing hands)
new_plays_proposed.read: a void is price DISCOVERING where liquidity actually sits; once found, flow stops moving price. The impact coefficient collapses in the following session and stays collapsed for an undetermined span.
new_plays_proposed.call: after a void, expect the impact regime to be numb IN BOTH DIRECTIONS - this predicts quiet on up days too, not just continued decline
new_plays_proposed.requires: phase signed flow and phase price change (tape_conditions)
new_plays_proposed.scope: SEQUENCE claimed; DURATION explicitly NOT claimed
new_plays_proposed.evidence: G23 0709 is the archetype: phase 2 fell -1,860 on -11 net flow across 98,400 lots. The k3 series after it: 0.302 -> 0.026 -> 0.018, with week-2 flows of +3,747/+6,326/+1,089/+1,333 producing +200/-60/-20/+180. C-0715 supplies the exact mirror six sessions apart in the same contract: 0709 = price without flow, 0715 = flow without price (+6,210 net across 68,115 lots for -80) - usd per unit net flow 1.322 vs 0.009, a factor of 147.
new_plays_proposed.forward_evidence: CORPUS SEARCHED, INSTANCES FOUND (D24 state a): the void-signature scan across four groups returns EXACTLY TWO instances - g23 0709 and g20 0529 - both followed within one session by a k3 collapse. Duration differs (g20 one session, g23 four), which is why duration is not claimed.
new_plays_proposed.falsifier: a void followed by an intact impact coefficient in the next session

new_plays_proposed.trigger: a phase whose price moves materially while net signed flow is near zero
new_plays_proposed.read: this is a WITHDRAWN BOOK, not absorption. Nothing was transferred, so the level was never tested and tends to be pressed again. True absorption is size CHANGING HANDS against price - flow present, price refusing.
new_plays_proposed.call: do not read a flowless reprice as a transfer of position or as exhaustion; a withdrawn book CONTINUES while an absent book ROUND-TRIPS
new_plays_proposed.requires: phase signed flow, phase price change, phase volume; separating the two objects needs TWO axes - flow intensity AND price efficiency (E-0717's correction to its own proposal)
new_plays_proposed.evidence: E-0710 named it on 0709 ph2 (-1,860 on -11 net across 98,400 lots) and reported its own inverted error honestly: it had called the genuinely absorbing phase (ph3, +1,390 of buying purchasing -160, ph_absorb TRUE in the file it was reading) a bullish 'buy handover' - polarity inverted on the flagged phase, label misapplied to the unflagged one, both errors pushing less bearish.
new_plays_proposed.forward_evidence: IN-BLOCK, BOTH POLARITIES, n=3 (E-0717) - and E found the proposal AS WRITTEN would have mislabelled its own morning phase, which is what forced the two-axis form. B-0713 supplies the counter-object the proposal needed: two flowless phases in the same block, 530x apart in price response, with opposite outcomes. BLIND-AVAILABLE DISCRIMINATOR OFFERED WITH AN HONEST NEGATIVE ATTACHED (E-0710): l1_book.quote_bid_share printed the block minimum 0.475 on 0709 - but it is NOT a day-ahead direction signal (6/10 in-block; C-0715 measured it null at 9 fires / 4 hits across G21-G23 and diagnosed the cause - the session mean spans only 0.475-0.512 while its own served intraday p25/p75 is [0.333, 0.667], so the aggregation destroys it). It is a LABELLER for the flowless case only.
new_plays_proposed.falsifier: a flowless reprice that behaves like absorption (level holds, no re-press) with no other driver

new_plays_proposed.trigger: an EIA print day whose reopen-to-10:30 window delivered an UP run of >= +300
new_plays_proposed.read: the 60-SECOND post-release impulse arbitrates continuation vs full round-trip. Inside +-300 the pre-print run continues; at <= -300 it round-trips entirely.
new_plays_proposed.call: use the first-minute impulse as the day's arbiter on pre-run-up print days; do not size the day from the surprise sign
new_plays_proposed.requires: intraday tape at 60-second resolution around 10:30 ET
new_plays_proposed.scope: print Thursdays with a material pre-print up run
new_plays_proposed.evidence: D-0716. The day it was found on: the session HIGH printed at 10:29:06, fifty-four seconds BEFORE the release, then -570 in nine seconds. And the decisive fact against surprise-sign reasoning: the print came in at +41 Bcf against a ~45 survey - a BULLISH surprise - and the market sold it 1,410 points in 33 minutes.
new_plays_proposed.forward_evidence: CORPUS SEARCHED, INSTANCES FOUND (D24 state a): 6/6 across FIVE groups - inside +-300 continues (0416, 0430, 0528, 0604); <= -300 round-trips (0625, 0716). STABILITY MEASURED: holds at 30s, 60s and 120s and DEGRADES at 300s, which places the arbiter inside the first two minutes - exactly where the established futures->Kalshi lag says the platform's edge lives.

new_plays_proposed.trigger: SAME-DAY session buy flow above +1000 lots, rising in force above +1500 / +2000 / +3000
new_plays_proposed.read: heavy buy aggression is a SAME-DAY bearish tell and the asymmetry is one-sided: buy flow agrees with price 41% / 29% / 25% / 20% as the threshold rises (monotone), while the SELL side is flat at 46 / 43 / 46 / 47%. It is NOT a next-day signal - the D-1 version is a coin flip.
new_plays_proposed.call: never read a large same-day buy tilt as next-day bullish evidence; on the day itself, heavy buy aggression into a level is a warning, not a confirmation
new_plays_proposed.scope: SAME-DAY only. Explicitly refuted as a D-1 instrument (4/9).
new_plays_proposed.evidence: D-0716, and it names its own blind's error with it: the blind cited 0715's +6,326 - the largest buy flow in seven groups - as bullish evidence, reading a same-day bearish tell as a next-day bullish one. C-0715's day is the mechanism: +6,326 of net aggressor BUY across 72,162 lots, the block's largest tilt by 69%, delivered -60, with ph3 flow_conviction NEGATIVE and absorption strengthening as the session ran.
new_plays_proposed.forward_evidence: CORPUS SEARCHED, INSTANCES FOUND (D24 state a): all 70 sessions across the walked groups; monotone across four thresholds; 8 of 10 extreme days closed down.
new_plays_proposed.falsifier: a threshold band where heavy buy flow agrees with price at or above the sell side's rate

new_plays_proposed.trigger: a burn reading is available as evidence for a directional weather lean
new_plays_proposed.read: burn confirms that weather-driven DEMAND ARRIVED. It does not price it. Direction needs a balance-clearing term - whether the arriving demand is clearing the surplus - because burn is a numerator with no denominator.
new_plays_proposed.call: burn may CONFIRM demand arrival and may DAMP a lean that contradicts it (the surviving limb of the retired gate); it may NEVER license a directional lean of its own, and must never act as a SUPPRESSOR before magnitude is derived
new_plays_proposed.requires: grid_stack burn (D+2 stale by construction - a backward-looking instrument, labelled as such) AND a balance term
new_plays_proposed.scope: successor to the retired weather.burn_conversion_gate; the damper limb is what carries forward (0709 and 0710 both wind-ramping, both fell)
new_plays_proposed.evidence: E-0710's mechanism, D-0716's supply of the missing term: E's balance-clearing successor WOULD have sorted D's day in the specific form storage.vs_5yr and its WoW delta - 112 -> 151 -> 156 -> 162 while injections collapsed 87 -> 61 -> 41, both decision-time-visible in the same served state file and used by neither specialist.
new_plays_proposed.forward_evidence: HONEST AND THIN, stated as such by D-0716: as a gate REVOCATION the balance term is 2/3 (right 0709, right 0716, wrong 0618); as a STANDALONE DIRECTION SORTER it is 4/7 and D explicitly does NOT claim it as one. E offers a further reformulation as a MEASUREMENT TO RUN, not a play to fire (n=1 clean): re-aim the instrument from price to FLOW, since on the block's extreme day it called the order flow correctly and the price exactly wrong - the missing denominator may be resting supply at execution rather than a balance term.
new_plays_proposed.falsifier: a block where burn licenses a directional lean that delivers, with the balance term pointing the other way
